newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Oct bad-cheque rate rises to 0.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Oct bad-cheque rate rises to 0.64 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's bad-cheque ratio rose to 0.64 percent in October from 0.62 percent in September, the central bank said in a statement on Friday.
Bad cheques made up 0.40 percent of the total value of all cheques written, down slightly from 0.41 percent in September and marking the lowest percentage since February 1995, the statement said.
The total number of bad cheques was down 11.46 percent from September while the value of bad cheques decreased 6.73 percent.
The central bank did not give specific totals for the value and number of bad cheques.
It attributed the drops to the last day of the month -- a day that routinely sees many bad cheques -- being a national holiday in October.
